Neutralize EarnFM bandwidth sharing

Stops the EarnFM (FleetSdk) SDK from sharing the device's spare network bandwidth. The SDK stays present, but initialize() and startSdk() return false so no native harvester or foreground sharing is started.

Neutralize Hopmn bandwidth sharing
Stops the Hopmn SDK from selling your upload bandwidth. The service stays declared so the app does not crash, but it acquires no wake lock, registers nothing and stops itself immediately.
